cases.sentence: Давид взял золотую корону с головы их царя — она весила талант и была украшена ___, — и возложил ее на свою голову .
cases.explain: «драгоценным камнем» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it. It was set on David’s head, and he brought very much plunder out of the city.

cases.sentence: Он вывел жителей, которые были в нем, заставив их работать пилами, ___ и топорами .
cases.explain: «железными кирками» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

cases.explain: «аммонитскими городами» — after the preposition «со», the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: He brought out the people who were in it, and had them cut with saws, with iron picks, and with axes. David did so to all the cities of the children of Ammon. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

cases.sentence: Некоторое время спустя произошло ___ с филистимлянами в Гезере.
cases.explain: «новое сражение» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: After this, war arose at Gezer with the Philistines. Then Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, of the sons of the giant; and they were subdued.

cases.sentence: В ___ с филистимлянами Элханан, сын Иаира, убил Лахмия, брата гатянина Голиафа, у которого древко копья было большое, как ткацкий навой.
cases.explain: «другом сражении» — after the preposition «в», for location or topic.
cases.translation: Again there was war with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, the staff of whose spear was like a weaver’s beam.

cases.sentence: Во время еще одной битвы, которая произошла в Гате, был некий человек ___, у которого было по шесть пальцев на каждой руке и на каждой ноге — всего двадцать четыре.
cases.explain: «огромного роста» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: There was again war at Gath, where there was a man of great stature, who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand, and six on each foot; and he also was born to the giant.
